feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 12 November 2026 11:00am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 12 November 2026 at 11:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Deep area of low pressure over Sweden and high pressure to the northwest of Ireland extending a ridge across the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

Northerly 4 or 5, backing north or northwest 3 or 4 overnight. Backing west later tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight overnight.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then showers developing overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 3 or 4, backing west or southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Saturday, backing south or southwest 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate overnight, then mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers becoming occasional later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
